author: boxtopics
quote: Hear me out its a GOOD Pikmin game BUT it takes away the original gritty feel from 1 and 2 the game's tutorial is to long and it treats you as if you don't know what Pikmin is and its annoying it wont let nature naturally kill a Pikmin ONCE! so its unrealistic and also oatchi... that weird dog.... i cant STAND HIM in the game you can ride him to bring your Pikmin together instead of them all out like the original games it is just to easy and I don't like that its influencing new short films to be weird and polished like cringey like the film (close to you) and not post apocalyptic earth. would I recommend the game yeah sure why not but just to warn you its not the BEST out of the franchise though you might like it. it depends if you like the games from cuteness or seeing it from its horror side this is the game you will want if you see the games from the cute side

author: boxtopics
quote: scariest game I have EVER played it installs a deep fear of God and ditches cheap jump scares with horror atmosphere this is indeed the GREATEST horror game I have ever played the music is so AMAZING!!! and the plot and endings are so perfect and scary. I first played this months ago and I still have nightmares though don't take my word for it you might not find it as scary as I do it just hits me in a different way then some others but I highly recommend this game to whomever is craving a deep COSMIC HORROR/Lovecraftian game that isnt a single hour long this game if you want to 100 percent it with all endings can take you a very long time to beat its filled with so much beautiful pixel art everywhere  i never new a 16 bit game could scare me so badly!

author: boxtopics
quote: One of if not the greatest game of all time don't listen to any of those grand theft auto 6 supporters they can't handle their game losing to a 28-year-old masterpiece. little do they know this game's base plate of programming literally set the rules of 3d gaming up until now this game is my childhood... my soul... and I would defend this game with my life and die in honor knowing I was defending this game... children from this generation may never understand what its like to stay up all night playing ocarina of time eating junk food just being young and stupid and living life. maybe its just me but this game hits in a way no other does... thank you Shigeru Miyamoto. thank you for making my childhood worth living in rough times
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
